additions.name: Nissan internal spine 2
additions.basis: Individually traced continuous main private aisle; source main-aisle paired opposing arrows support bidirectional access. No one-way storage-row lane is included.

additions.name: Nissan internal spine 3
additions.basis: Individually traced continuous main private aisle; source main-aisle paired opposing arrows support bidirectional access. No one-way storage-row lane is included.

additions.name: Nissan internal main divider
additions.basis: Visible continuous transverse main aisle and its four actual junctions. Source block ordering and paired crossing arrows distinguish this from narrow one-way storage rows.

VE.association: Western bank. The two printed VE sub-blocks lie on opposite sides of this independently matched main cross-aisle, between the western perimeter and first long internal spine. Shared approach to that named group, not a terminal-centre fallback.

VD.association: Middle bank. Its repeated VD blocks share the actual main cross-aisle between the first and second long internal spines; source neighbours VE and VC/VA fix the ordinal bank independently.

VK.association: Roadside bank immediately on the V-field side of the main cross-aisle, between the second long internal spine and roadside perimeter. The source VK block is distinct from the larger VC/VA strips beyond this divider.

VC.association: Inner half of the long roadside bank north of the main divider. The source assigns VC to the inner row strips adjoining the VD/VC main spine; the approach uses that actual bank boundary, not an inferred internal row.

VA.association: Road-facing half of the same long roadside bank north of the main divider. Its actual roadside private aisle is separate from VC on the inner side.

VAX.association: Named frontage strip along the VA side of the Jozef-facing private perimeter. It shares that real access aisle with VA; it is not a separately invented car-row centre.

VH001.association: Named outer frontage along the main VE bank, on the northern branch of the western perimeter. Actual outward road direction is retained from the source arrows.

VH002.association: Named outer frontage along the smaller VE/V side of the same western perimeter, on its separate southern branch. This is distinct from VH001 beyond the main divider.

VZ001.association: Road-facing perimeter strip at the V end of the field, separate from the VAX/VA frontage beyond the main divider. Arrival stays on the reviewed private roadside aisle.

VZ002.association: Named terminal-end VZ002 frontage across the seven-bay V field. Arrival is on the visible first long aisle about6m before its terminal end, as an access-side reference. The shadowed fence-side transverse strip is NOT drawn as a new road.

unresolved.VB: The source triangular northern roadside wedge and its numbered VB strip cannot be bounded independently in the2025 rectilinear office-side layout. Do not reuse the office forecourt or VA point.
unresolved.VF: The northern western/middle-bank cut-out has changed around the industrial edge. The current road is visible, but the exact printed VF frontage cannot be individually identified from the source shape.
unresolved.VG: The source office/gate-side angled frontage cannot be reconciled to a unique current private parcel boundary; the northern staging-yard driveway is not automatically the Nissan carfield gate.

publicGateAudit.reason: The northern Jozef opening serves a staging forecourt. A continuous road-side fence exists south of the office, and the transfer around the office-west gate/fence needs positive verification. No public-road split or exterior connection is proposed.

trafficEvidence.basis: Preserve the source perimeter outward arrows for VH001 and VH002; use only the wider main aisles/crossings with paired travel arrows. Narrow one-way storage aisles and their prohibited turn shortcuts are not digitized. Current on-site signs and gate permissions remain unverified.
trafficEvidence.limits: Internal road approaches and lane references only; no surveyed parking-line coordinates or cross-port route certification.

rejectedCrossings.reason: Close-up review shows vehicle-storage rows and painted empty storage bays at this apparent cross line; no continuous drivable cross-aisle is proved.
The source terminal-end perimeter band lies largely in fence shadow in the photo. Do not invent a drivable connection across that shadow; use visible long-aisle-side arrivals.

limitations: The West-south one-way perimeter is retained only through observed clear asphalt. Its onward terminal-end connection is not digitized. Routes leaving that spur may be unavailable; no false loop or traffic reversal is added.
Internal arrival certification is tested independently from VA and VH001 origins. No external Jozef transfer is certified.
coordinateMethod: Exact pixel georeference of the official WMS raster. These are independently observed road controls, not an affine fit from source labels.
